int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_config ( DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle  handle,
DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *  pConfigIn 
)

Description
The function is rangeProc DPU config function. It saves buffer pointer and configurations including system resources and configures HWA and EDMA for runtime range processing.

Precondition
DPU_RangeProcHWA_init() has been called
Parameters
[in]handlerangeProc DPU handle
[in]pConfigInPointer to rangeProc configuration data structure
Return values
Success- 0
